spans.text: Logo Baŋa Tigisim Wadɛ sem se ko taa ye woŋ-kolo kodoo na wo woli ko ja wopwolo de logo fɔgem de yezura na wo pa nabiina ŋwea taa jege kuri logo baŋa maama ne to.
Logo baŋa tigisim wadɛ sem pɛ chwoŋa se nɔɔno maama taa jege chega chwoŋa na wo pa ba ŋwea taa jege zula to.
Logo baŋa wadɛ sem maama yiga ne, wadaa teira na wo ta we o dae nabiinu.

entries.task_id: wadɛ|sem|ta we ba ba fee nabiinu o chega chwoŋa ne naa ba chɛɛse o dwi o yetana
entries.description: Wadɛ sem ta we ba ba fee nabiinu o chega chwoŋa ne naa ba chɛɛse o dwi o yetana
entries.subject: Wadɛ
entries.object: ta we ba ba fee nabiinu o chega chwoŋa ne naa ba chɛɛse o dwi o yetana

spans.text: Wadɛ sem ta we ba ba fee nabiinu o chega chwoŋa ne naa ba chɛɛse o dwi o yetana, o logo lane, o wɛ jɔɔnɔ naa o boboŋa ŋwaane.
Wadɛ sem ta we ba ba jege se ba taa chɛɛse nɔɔno we o ye baaro naa kaane, kwoo o jejegero naa ba na loge o mɛ to ŋwaane.
Wadɛ sem ta tage se woli da we popɔra ba jege se ka taa wora nabiina laŋa ne ba teo politiksi naa ko wadɛ naa ko na ye kolo to ŋwaane.

spans.text: De ko de, o cham dem na dae nenɛɛne politiksi laŋa ne ko wo taa chamma se o duri o nwoŋ.

folded.id: nɔɔna wɛchwoŋa|kam|o taane de o totoŋa seini
folded.subject: nɔɔna Wɛchwoŋa
folded.object: o taane de o totoŋa seini

spans.text: O wae o ke o boboŋa keiri, o wae o tɔge Wɛchwoŋa kalo dwi o na lage to; o nam ta wae o leiri o Wɛchwoŋa naa o boŋem o yerane naa o de kɔgɔ, ye o bere nɔɔna Wɛchwoŋa kam o taane de o totoŋa seini.

folded.id: nɔɔno wonno|naa|ba pa se o ye taa lage wonno
folded.subject: nɔɔno wonno
folded.object: ba pa se o ye taa lage wonno

spans.text: Ba baa wane ba vere nɔɔno wonno naa ba pa se o ye taa lage wonno.

folded.id: o chɔge|naa|ba ta we o ve se o yaa ke kolo na maŋe keim chega chwoŋa ne to
folded.subject: o chɔge
folded.object: ba ta we o ve se o yaa ke kolo na maŋe keim chega chwoŋa ne to

spans.text: Ba baa wane ba ta we nɔɔno yaa ke o chɔge naa ba ta we o ve se o yaa ke kolo na maŋe keim chega chwoŋa ne to, ye ka maŋa ne wadaa yaa teira ko ŋwaane.

folded.id: o jejegero|naa|ba na loge o mɛ to ŋwaane
folded.subject: o jejegero
folded.object: ba na loge o mɛ to ŋwaane

spans.text: Wadɛ sem ta we ba ba jege se ba taa chɛɛse nɔɔno we o ye baaro naa kaane, kwoo o jejegero naa ba na loge o mɛ to ŋwaane.

folded.id: o wɛchwoŋa|naa|o boŋem o yerane naa o de kɔgɔ
folded.subject: o Wɛchwoŋa
folded.object: o boŋem o yerane naa o de kɔgɔ

spans.text: O wae o ke o boboŋa keiri, o wae o tɔge Wɛchwoŋa kalo dwi o na lage to; o nam ta wae o leiri o Wɛchwoŋa naa o boŋem o yerane naa o de kɔgɔ, ye o bere nɔɔna Wɛchwoŋa kam o taane de o totoŋa seini.

folded.id: paŋ o|wo|mɛ maama logo baŋa yoba
folded.subject: paŋ o
folded.object: mɛ maama logo baŋa yoba

spans.text: Nɔɔno maama ye nabiinu mo o ze paŋ o wo mɛ maama logo baŋa yoba.

folded.id: peena diga|naa|ba zeili o o teo ne pa o vo zoora te-gaa ne
folded.subject: peena diga
folded.object: ba zeili o o teo ne pa o vo zoora te-gaa ne

spans.text: Ba baa wane ba ja nɔɔno yɔɔ yerane ba gare ba ke o peena diga naa ba zeili o o teo ne pa o vo zoora te-gaa ne.

folded.id: se wadɛ|sem|ja kuri
folded.subject: se wadɛ
folded.object: ja kuri

spans.text: De na sɛ we nɔɔno maama taa tei o tete se tigura de popɔra ye taa wora, fefeo de peenem ŋwaane, se wadɛ sem ja kuri.

folded.id: sɛ we|teene|maama taa jege wolim
folded.subject: sɛ we
folded.object: maama taa jege wolim

spans.text: De na sɛ we teene maama taa jege wolim, de ni sɛɛm de mimɔrɔ.

folded.id: ta na|wo|vere ko tete to ŋwaane
folded.subject: ta na
folded.object: vere ko tete to ŋwaane

spans.text: Naa ba pɔɔre nɔɔno we o nwoŋi teo kolo ta na wo vere ko tete to ŋwaane.

folded.id: teira na|wo|ta we o dae nabiinu
folded.subject: teira na
folded.object: ta we o dae nabiinu

spans.text: Logo baŋa wadɛ sem maama yiga ne, wadaa teira na wo ta we o dae nabiinu.

folded.id: teo kom|wadɛ|na tiŋi tei to ba ni o seene o chɔge naa o wo chɔge
folded.subject: teo kom
folded.object: na tiŋi tei to ba ni o seene o chɔge naa o wo chɔge

spans.text: Ba na jaane nɔɔno fee wora se ba di o sareya kɔɔte ne lanyerane ko maŋ de teo kom wadɛ na tiŋi tei to ba ni o seene o chɔge naa o wo chɔge.
O na chɔge teo kom wadɛ gɛ mo naa o kekeo kom na wo dɛ UN wadɛ sem na maŋe tei to sateene dedwonna baa sɛ de jwoŋ o mɔle mɔle.

folded.id: teo kom|wadɛ|selo na pa nɔɔno wom ŋwea ywona to
folded.subject: teo kom
folded.object: selo na pa nɔɔno wom ŋwea ywona to

spans.text: Nɔɔno maama wae o saŋ nɔɔno o dwoŋ kɔɔte delo maama wone nenɛɛne ko tu na ke o chɔge teo kom wadɛ selo na pa nɔɔno wom ŋwea ywona to.

folded.id: tɔge wɛchoŋa|kalo|dwi to baa wane ko cheiŋi ba se ba ye di daane ba lɔ sɔŋɔ
folded.subject: tɔge Wɛchoŋa
folded.object: dwi to baa wane ko cheiŋi ba se ba ye di daane ba lɔ sɔŋɔ

spans.text: Baara de kaana na bege ba ti to wae ba di daane ye ba yetana, naa ba na nwoŋ tekolo, naa ba na tɔge Wɛchoŋa kalo dwi to baa wane ko cheiŋi ba se ba ye di daane ba lɔ sɔŋɔ.
O wae o ke o boboŋa keiri, o wae o tɔge Wɛchwoŋa kalo dwi o na lage to; o nam ta wae o leiri o Wɛchwoŋa naa o boŋem o yerane naa o de kɔgɔ, ye o bere nɔɔna Wɛchwoŋa kam o taane de o totoŋa seini.

folded.id: un tigisim|teene|dem maama ke nimɔrɔ se chega chwoŋa wadɛ sem ja kuri nabiina zula de wopwolo ŋwaane
folded.subject: UN Tigisim
folded.object: dem maama ke nimɔrɔ se chega chwoŋa wadɛ sem ja kuri nabiina zula de wopwolo ŋwaane

spans.text: De na sɛ we UN Tigisim teene dem maama ke nimɔrɔ se chega chwoŋa wadɛ sem ja kuri nabiina zula de wopwolo ŋwaane.

folded.id: voti wadaa|kam|naga chekke
folded.subject: voti wadaa
folded.object: naga chekke

spans.text: Kurim dem jege se ko dɛ voti lao naga mo, se nɔɔno maama voti o boboŋa na laga tei to, ye se ko dɛ voti wadaa kam naga chekke.

folded.id: wadaa|kam|we nabiin-yeiku naa kabɛ totoŋa naa kabɛ pipio daa ye taa wora logo baŋa ne
folded.subject: Wadaa
folded.object: we nabiin-yeiku naa kabɛ totoŋa naa kabɛ pipio daa ye taa wora logo baŋa ne

spans.text: Wadaa kam we nabiin-yeiku naa kabɛ totoŋa naa kabɛ pipio daa ye taa wora logo baŋa ne.

folded.id: wadɛ|sem|ta we ba ba fee nabiinu o chega chwoŋa ne naa ba chɛɛse o dwi o yetana
folded.subject: Wadɛ
folded.object: ta we ba ba fee nabiinu o chega chwoŋa ne naa ba chɛɛse o dwi o yetana

spans.text: Wadɛ sem ta we ba ba fee nabiinu o chega chwoŋa ne naa ba chɛɛse o dwi o yetana, o logo lane, o wɛ jɔɔnɔ naa o boboŋa ŋwaane.
Wadɛ sem ta we ba ba jege se ba taa chɛɛse nɔɔno we o ye baaro naa kaane, kwoo o jejegero naa ba na loge o mɛ to ŋwaane.
Wadɛ sem ta tage se woli da we popɔra ba jege se ka taa wora nabiina laŋa ne ba teo politiksi naa ko wadɛ naa ko na ye kolo to ŋwaane.

folded.id: we ba|wo|zaŋ ba le o totoŋ dem ne to
folded.subject: we ba
folded.object: zaŋ ba le o totoŋ dem ne to

spans.text: Nɔɔno maama wae o ke totoŋ; o wae o kuri o boboŋa na dɛ totoŋ delo, ye fee wora se totoŋ dem taa jege kuri na pa o ywonni de wopwolo ye o ba lia we ba wo zaŋ ba le o totoŋ dem ne to.

folded.id: wɛ jɔɔnɔ|naa|o boboŋa ŋwaane
folded.subject: wɛ jɔɔnɔ
folded.object: o boboŋa ŋwaane

spans.text: Wadɛ sem ta we ba ba fee nabiinu o chega chwoŋa ne naa ba chɛɛse o dwi o yetana, o logo lane, o wɛ jɔɔnɔ naa o boboŋa ŋwaane.

folded.id: yaa na|wo|jwoŋ o na chɔge maŋa kalo to
folded.subject: yaa na
folded.object: jwoŋ o na chɔge maŋa kalo to

spans.text: Ko kwaga ne tata ba baa wane ba pa nɔɔno waarem na dage de dwoi waarem delo dwi o deim yaa na wo jwoŋ o na chɔge maŋa kalo to.

folded.id: yalo na|wo|woli o o totoŋa laŋa seini to
folded.subject: yalo na
folded.object: woli o o totoŋa laŋa seini to

spans.text: Nɔɔno maama wae o tɔge o zoore totoŋa jei tigisim yalo na wo woli o o totoŋa laŋa seini to.

folded.id: ye fefeo|naa|foonee teira
folded.subject: ye fefeo
folded.object: foonee teira

spans.text: Ko ye nɔɔno maama chega chwoŋa mo se o taa ŋwe ye fefeo naa foonee teira.

folded.id: zoore asɛmble|naa|tigisim dwi maama na ye yezura tigisim to
folded.subject: zoore asɛmble
folded.object: tigisim dwi maama na ye yezura tigisim to

spans.text: Nɔɔno maama wae o tɔge o zoore asɛmble naa tigisim dwi maama na ye yezura tigisim to.
